item.title: BMU sets new vote after budget defeat
item.description: WELLS RIVER—After suffering a budget defeat at the polls during town meeting day on March 3, the Blue Mountain Union School Board has amended the budget and set a date for a new vote.

item.title: Twenty fire departments respond to Vershire fire
item.description: VERSHIRE—Four families were displaced after a devastating four-alarm fire destroyed a home in Vershire on March 2. Area fire departments were dispatched at approximately 9 a.m. to 9246 Route 113 in Vershire. It quickly escalated into a fourth alarm assignment. Some 75 firefighters and 20 fire departments responded to the scene or provided station coverage […]

item.title: Route 5 in Fairlee remains closed
item.description: FAIRLEE — A roughly 1-mile stretch of Route 5 in Fairlee will remain closed for at least a couple of weeks because rocks are continuing to fall off the face of a ledge where a rockslide occurred on the afternoon of March 10.

item.title: Bradford Town Administrator to resign
item.description: BRADFORD—Town Administrator Danielle Kingsbury has submitted her resignation effective April 6.

item.title: Northeast Slopes celebrates 90 years
item.description: EAST CORINTH—Northeast Slopes in East Corinth celebrated its 90th year of operations on a balmy, late winter day earlier this month. On March 15, between 150 and 200 people gathered at the slopes to celebrate its granite anniversary.

item.title: Journal Opinion wins three NENPA awards
item.description: PORTSMOUTH—The Journal Opinion was recognized in the New England Newspaper and Press Association’s annual Better Newspapers competition. The awards were announced at the annual NENPA conference in Portsmouth on March 14. The JO won three awards, including two in the editorial division, for work published between Aug. 1, 2024 and July 31, 2025.

item.title: Berlin man dies in Orange collision
item.description: ORANGE—A motor vehicle crash in snowy conditions on Route 302 in Orange claimed the life of a Berlin, Vermont man on March 20.
